_what: Source of truth for audio_pitch, a streaming one-bit pitch detector. train.py fits the threshold to generated labelled square waves; golden.py is the bit-exact cycle-level reference; gen_rom.py writes the ROM and the testbench vectors.

training.label: 1 = high tone (square wave with half-period 2 or 3 samples), 0 = low tone (half-period 8 or 12); every phase; each clean window plus 3 copies with one flipped sample

stream.input: one sample per beat; s_data[0] = sign bit of the waveform; s_data[7:1] must be 0 (else error); s_last marks the last sample of a recording and clears the history
stream.output: one beat per input beat once W samples of the recording have been seen (warm-up = first W-1 samples, no output); m_data = {error, class, count[5:0]}; m_last = s_last of the input beat
stream.count: number of sign changes among the last W samples (0..W-1)
stream.error: a bad sample (s_data[7:1] != 0, its bit 0 is still used) sets a flag that rides on the next result beat (this beat if warm) and then clears; it is dropped if the recording ends first
stream.latency: the result beat is registered: m_valid rises on the clock edge that accepts the input beat
stream.flow: s_ready = !m_valid || m_ready (one result register, no combinational path from s_valid to m_valid)
